description:
1. The agent must read references/flyai-cli-docs.md to discover the correct CLI syntax (flyai flight search --from --to --date --json), NOT the wrong syntax in the SKILL.md body (flyai search-flight --origin). Running the correct CLI command against the mock returns the 5 Beijing-Chengdu flights.
2. The agent selects the top 3 flights from the raw results list (CA4101@680, 3U8501@650, MU2301@720), sets basePrice to the minimum (650), marks 3U8501 with isBaseFlight=true, preserves all jumpUrl fields, sets thresholdPercent=10, thresholdAmount=200, status=active, expiresAt 7 days after createdAt.
3. For alert evaluation: Day 1 — no alerts (3U8501 drops only 5.4%, under both thresholds). Day 2 — 3U8501 triggers an alert (drops ¥210 = 32.3%, satisfies EITHER the 10% OR ¥200 threshold per 'satisfy any one' rule). Day 3 — 3U8501 is SUPPRESSED by the 24-hour anti-spam rule (lastAlertAt was day 2); CA4101 triggers a new alert (drops ¥230 from 680, a different flight so no 24h conflict); MU2301 triggers a RISE alert (rises ¥180 = 25%, exceeding the asymmetric 15%/¥300 rise threshold — specifically ¥180 < ¥300 but 25% > 15%, so triggered by percent).
